verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes a documented Developer API (OpenAPI spec with 174 paths, including /developer/v1/banking/accounts) with dedicated accounting scopes (accounting:read, accounting:write), a Transactions API for retrieving/coding transaction data, a CLI 'accounting' resource, and real-time bidirectional ERP sync described in docs. Sandbox and webhooks let developers safely test and receive accounting-event notifications. Missing for 10: dedicated Accounting API guide analogous to the Banking guide, and independent/hands-on developer confirmation of GL-account read/write behavior.
